is_anopheles.evidence: Studies members of the Anopheles gambiae species complex: Anopheles gambiae, Anopheles coluzzii, and Anopheles arabiensis (page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report primary target marker genotyping data. It only mentions kdr frequency as metadata retrieved from previously published microarray studies (page 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable target-site genotype counts or allele frequencies with sample sizes are reported for field mosquito populations.

african_field_population.evidence: Re-analyses transcriptomic datasets from field-caught/reared mosquitoes collected across multiple African countries (e.g., Côte d'Ivoire, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Tanzania; Fig. 1, page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a transcriptomic meta-analysis re-analysing 31 previously published microarray datasets retrieved from existing literature (refs 7-18, page 2).

sub_country_location.evidence: Datasets are mapped to specific sub-country collection sites across Africa, such as Tiassalé, VK7, Banfora, M'Be, Bouaké, etc. (Fig. 1, page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Metadata for the datasets spans 5 years of collections (2009-2014) with collection windows specified for each dataset (page 2, page 9).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study explicitly re-analyses 31 previously published microarray datasets retrieved from published literature (refs 7-18, page 2).

supplement.evidence: Supplementary materials are not needed as the paper fails core eligibility checks (meta-analysis lacking primary marker genotyping data).

assessment.summary: This article presents a transcriptomic meta-analysis of 31 previously published microarray datasets comparing pyrethroid-resistant and susceptible Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations from sub-Saharan Africa. It identifies gene families (α-crystallins, hexamerins, ATPase subunits) and transcription factors associated with resistance, validated via RNAi and qPCR in lab colonies. It does not report primary target-site marker genotyping data.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report primary target marker genotyping data for field populations
Is a meta-analysis re-analysing previously published transcriptomic datasets
